title: CrystalReasoner: Reasoning and RL for Property-Conditioned Crystal Structure Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.14344v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative modeling has emerged as a promising approach for crystal structure discovery. However, existing LLM-based generative models struggle with low-level atomic precision, while diffusion-based methods fall short in integrating high-level scientific knowledge. As a result, generated structures are often invalid, unstable, or do not possess desirable properties. To address this gap, we propose CrystalReasoner (CrysReas), an end-to-end LLM framework that generates crystal structures from natural language instructions through reasoning and alignment. CrysReas introduces physical priors as thinking tokens, which include crystallographic symmetry, local coordination environments and predicted physical properties before generating atomic coordinates. translated_title: CrystalReasoner：面向性质条件化晶体结构生成的推理与强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 生成式建模已成为晶体结构发现的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成模型在底层原子精度方面表现不佳，而基于扩散的方法则难以整合高层科学知识，导致生成的结构往往无效、不稳定或不具备理想的性质。为解决这一差距，我们提出了 CrystalReasoner（CrysReas），一个端到端的 LLM 框架，能够通过推理与对齐从自然语言指令生成晶体结构。CrysReas 引入物理先验作为“思考 token”，在生成原子坐标之前先对晶体学对称性、局部配位环境以及预测的物理性质进行推理，从而在自然语言与三维结构之间架起桥梁。随后，CrysReas 采用带有多目标、密集奖励函数的强化学习（RL），使生成结果与性质要求对齐。
tldr: CrystalReasoner 提出了一个端到端的大语言模型框架，通过将晶体学对称性、配位环境和预测物理性质等物理先验作为“思考 token”进行推理，并利用多目标密集奖励的强化学习进行对齐，从而从自然语言指令直接生成有效且具备目标性质的晶体结构。
en_tdlr: CrystalReasoner is an end-to-end LLM framework that generates property-conditioned crystal structures from natural language by encoding physical priors (crystallographic symmetry, local coordination environments, and predicted properties) as thinking tokens and aligning generation through multi-objective dense-reward reinforcement learning.
